name: I Am Bad Dog From Hell
summary: In I Am Bad Dog From Hell , you’re not just any dog—you’re a chaos-fueled prankster straight from the depths of canine mischief! Experience the mayhem in full VR from your own dog’s-eye view as you torment your cranky, relentless grandpa. Sneak into rooms to pop balloons, toss books from shelves, and flick the TV on just to watch him fume.
